title: Rampart hunt candidate
description: One candidate finding as hunt-io stores it (candidates/<hunterKey>.json holds an array). Agents write a raw form (a local ref, no candidateId); hunt-io overwrites system, layer, pack, packVersion, hunter and candidateId from units.json, redacts the text fields and replaces value-like evidence. A group hunter's raw candidate names its classId, which must be one of the hunter's bundle, and a location.path, which must be one of the group's files. candidateId is the id of the finding the candidate would become.

ref.description: The hunter's local reference, c1 to c20 (a group hunter reports up to 20 candidates over its class bundle; the INFRA prober up to 10); the candidateRef of a vote is <hunterKey>#<ref>.

agent.description: The hunterKey of the file the candidate came from: <group>__<bundle> (g03__b1) for a group hunter, <unit>__<classId> for a one-class hunter of a run before 0.5.0, <system>__infra-prober for INFRA.

unit.description: The unit of the candidate: for a group hunter the unit of its location.path, for an older hunter its one unit, null for INFRA.
